evidence.method: Every serious incomplete node returned by axe is resolved by its exact selector in its actual matrix cell. Exactly one DOM node must match, and its computed foreground and effective ancestor background are measured. The manifest stores the cell-bound selector, HTML, colors, ratio, and fingerprint; no selector allowlist is used.

scopeNote: axe cannot decide contrast for these single non-text glyphs. No rule, selector, node, or page is excluded; every returned serious or critical incomplete node must pass the actual-cell computed-DOM ratio gate.
